Decode payload first. Split on ASCII spaces, retaining empty fields. Process groups of at most 32 fields independently. For each group L, stably sort its indices by field text in ASCII lexicographic order; LF maps each old index to its sorted position. For each LF cycle collect L values, reverse them, and take the lexicographically least cyclic rotation. Sort these cycles in descending lexicographic order and concatenate. Join all fields with ASCII spaces; print only.
